text:
90+3' Substitution for Nigeria Semiu Ajayi don replace Ola Aina.
90+1 Taifa Stars player Msanga wey score Tanzania only goal make attempt to score as e fire shot but e go ova di side of di goalpost.
89' Nigeria defender Calvin Bassey just dey block any Tanzania player wey near di goal area.
86' MISS! Tolu Arokodare of Nigeria miss chance to score hat trick for di Super Eagles , e get clear chance to score but e fire di ball enta goalkeeper hand.
85' Substitution for Tanzania Suleiman don enta, Migo don comot.
83' SAVE! Nigeria goalkeeper Stanley Nwabali and defender Calvin Bassey clear di threat from di Taifa Stars wey bin wan enta net. Nwabali catch di ball.
79' Tanzania no wan gree for Nigeria as dem dey continue to press di Super Eagles to try score.
76' Nigeria player Akor Adams get chance to score again but e enta offside.
73' CHANCE!!! Tanzania get chance to reduce di goals tally but too many touches for di goal area no allow dem score.
70' Di tempo of di match don cool down small, Akor Adams make run towards Tanzania area but refereee blow for offside.
67' MISS! Akor Adams!!!! E miss beta chance to finish Tanzania for dis match.
60' Di striker wey just enta di game for dis second half score two goals
58' Tolu Arokodare get anoda chance to score but as im first di first touch, ekon spoil di ball.
56' Nigeria get di momentum now as dem dy try score more goals Tanzania sef dey chase dem.
Arokodare flick di ball inside net wit style as e give Nigeria di lead.
52' GOALLLLLLL for Nigeria! Tolu Arokodare score for di Super Eagles.
49' Tanzania players don wake up o, dem don begin worry Nigeria midfield.
Nigeria start dis second half wit action as dem dey surround Tanzania defence dey find goal.
47' Substitution for Nigeria Moses Simon don enta for Ademola Lookman, Moses Usor for Alhassan Yusuf. Tolu Arokodare replace Nnadi Tochukwu.
45' Chance! Nigeria get chance to score but Fredrick play di ball wey use go pastbdi net roof.
45' Alex Iwobi play di corner kick wey meet Nigeria players but notin comeout as di ball end for Tanzania goalkeeper hand.
45' Dem don carry Ademola Lookman comot from field sake of injury.
43' Corner kick for Nigeria, Alex Iwobi dey wait to play am but Ademola Lookman dey for ground dey get treatment.
40' Nigeria captain Wilfred Ndidi fire shot as e bin try to score but di ball go wide.
36' Nigeria player Akor Adams shade Tanzania goalkeeper sake of say e hold di ball too much.
Mabula Msanga score for di Taifa stars as e dribble Nigeria defender Calvin baasey and anoda defender to score
24' Nigeria player Alhassan Yusuf wey just score bin get anoda chance, e pass di ball to im teammate wey play di ball comot from di field.
20' Nigeria player fall for ground afta tackle from Tanzania player but e don stand up and game don continue.
15' Nigeria still dey control di ball but second goal neva come while Tanzania dey hustle to break Nigeria defence.
12' Nigeria player Alhassan Yusuf collect yellow card as e tackle Tanzania player.
10' Nigeria dey dominate do game so far as Akor no dey give di Taifa starts space to play di game.
7' Match don resume wit freeklick for Nigeria, dem play am toward goall but e go wide.
5' Tanzania player dey for ground dey collect medical attention afta e Nigerian opponent tackle am.
2' GOALLLLLLLL Alhassan Yusuf score for Nigeria. Alhassan Yusuf score afta Ademola Lookman pass ball give am.
Nigeria: Nwabali (GK), Fredricks, Bassey, Aina; Ndidi, Bwene, Iwobi, Alhassan; Lookman; Adams, Nnadi
Tanzania: Manula (GK); Chilambo, Mwamnyeto, Mlingo; Mao, Miroshi, Msanga, Kachwele, Denis, Hamad, Mnoga.
